Each was line 1 and read `# TODO(ownerN): confirm zone table with <name> account manager`.
- **Nothing else changed:** the diff shows only those 20 deleted lines. No match had code before the comment or sat inside a string, so none were left in place.
- **Tests:** pytest isn't installed and the repo has no test config, so I ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. All 6 tests passed.

Those comments were the only record that each carrier's zone table still needs to be checked with its account manager. If that work hasn't been done, you may want to track it somewhere else.
